Silicon-Native | Dual-Mode (Draft & Seal) | AI-First & Python-Interop Programming Language

Zafira is a modern Silicon-Native & Dual-Mode programming language designed specifically for the generative AI era. It communicates directly with silicon hardware (CPU, GPU, NPU) at the language grammar level while bridging high developer ergonomics with C/Rust-grade performance.
features: Choose Python for its expressiveness, rapid iteration, and unmatched AI ecosystem — at the cost of slow single-threaded execution, memory bloat, and runtime type fragility.
Choose C++ or Rust for bare-metal speed and type safety — at the cost of steep learning curves, verbose syntax, and long compile times.
draft Mode: Write freeform, dynamic code for ultra-fast prototyping without cumbersome boilerplate or strict annotations.
seal Mode: When preparing for production, seal functions with strict types and formal where invariants that are statically proven at compile-time before code ever runs.
Zero-Overhead Python Bridge: Seamlessly import any library in the Python universe (import py.torch, import py.pandas, import py.numpy) with zero FFI glue.
